function poseFromPos(p, t): [number, number, number]

Defined in: experiments/docs/arch-scene-3d.ts:117

Converts a saved world-space camera position into the orbit rig's spherical pose — the inverse of the Rust rig's target + d·(cos p·sin y, sin p, cos p·cos y).

p

Saved eye position.
